title: Lamb Stew with Mediterranean Vegetables
description: A hearty lamb stew with a mediterranean twist, featuring juicy vegetables and a rich flavor profile. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb shoulder and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, lemon juice, and oregano to the pot.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
